source: Captain daily collection photo (papergrid notebook) supplied by owner 2026-11-23. Original image not stored on disk; this is the human-verified transcription used as ground truth for extraction + reconciliation tests.
purpose: Test that the captain-accounting extractor (a) transcribes per-staff collection columns, (b) INDEPENDENTLY re-sums each column and flags any mismatch vs the handwritten total, (c) marks low-confidence cells for human review, and (d) refuses to auto-post because the cash line does not reconcile.
difficulty_notes: Mixed content: per-staff collection columns + an expense summary block + a cash reconciliation block, all on one page.
Some struck-through / smudged entries in the Google/GPay column.
Totals written by hand may round away the '+10' remainders (e.g. ASHKAR total written '2750+10' = 2760).

columns.name: ASHKAR
columns.entries_note: The 4th entry '50+10' captured as 60. Handwritten total '2750+10' = 2760.

columns.name: GOOGLE_GPAY
columns.entries_note: Partial / low confidence. Several cells struck through or smudged ('50+10', 'u400+10', a crossed value). Column not cleanly totalled on the page.

columns.name: LEFT_UNLABELED
columns.entries_note: Leftmost column, header illegible (possibly a date/'Google' split). '50+10' captured as 60. No handwritten total on page.

reconciliation_block_as_written.note: Uses the rounded column totals 2750 + 2650 = 5400. Then -1000 (unlabeled, likely online/GPay or a deposit) and -630 (the expenses block). 5400 - 1000 - 630 = 3770, which does NOT equal the circled CASH 370. Discrepancy is unexplained on the page.

reconciliation.unexplained_difference_note: 3770 expected cash vs 370 written = 3400 gap. The -1000 line is unlabeled and the online/GPay portion is not separated. System must ask the captain to classify collection vs online vs expense vs cash before the closing can be submitted.

expected_system_behavior.privacy: If this were rendered back to a captain, salary figures (none here) would be masked; owner-only.
